messages:
alex.s: Heads-up — EmberHealth asked for a small-batch endurance test before exec review. Target: 300 qps steady for 3 hours (chat-heavy: 70% chat, 30% embeddings). Need ops + perf to coordinate.
priya.se: Copy. Which models and fallback plan?
alex.s: Primary: rwd-llama-13b-8q (latency friendly). Secondary: rwd-llama-70b-bf16 for quality checks on a small percentage. Fallback: rwd-llama-7b-8q if latency spikes.
rui.eng: I'll run a mixed workload harness. Planning vegeta for chat traffic and a separate bulk runner for embeddings to avoid head-of-line blocking. Sharing run command shortly.
sam.ops: I'll reserve 3xA100 nodes in Dedicated pool ember-test-02. KMS access granted to ember-svc account. Will route logs to 'ember-poc-logs' bucket.
alex.s: Prospect wants an upfront estimate of monthly token cost if they sustain 300 qps for business hours (10h/day weekdays). Priya can you ballpark committed vs on-demand?
priya.se: Quick calc: 300 qps * 36000s/day * 22 days = ~237.6M requests; with avg tokens per chat 150 => ~35.6B tokens/month. Hosted 70b bf16 ~ $0.025/token-gen equiv => hosted ~$0.89M/month (very rough). Dedicated with 30% commit reduces to ~$0.62M; we'll add slide.
deploy-bot: Dedicated reservation initiated: ember-test-02 -> 3xA100. job=ej-4521
rui.eng: Run plan (short):
```
# chat load
vegeta attack -targets=chat_targets.txt -rate=210 -duration=3h | vegeta report -type=json > ember_chat_300qps.json
# embeddings load
parallel-requests --rate 90 --duration 3h --out ember_embed_300qps.json
```
rui.eng: Mix split enforced by separate generators, aggregated in postprocessing. We'll collect per-minute p50/p95/p99 and error rates.
alex.s: Start only after ops confirms KMS latency baseline — prospect worried about KMS adding tail latency.
sam.ops: KMS ping tests done: median 12ms, p95 48ms from the Dedicated subnet. I'll attach the latency histogram.
priya.se: Security ask: EmberHealth wants to confirm CMK rotation cadence and whether we can provide rotation on-demand during the POC. Sam?
sam.ops: Default rotation annual, but we can perform rotation on-demand for test; will do manual rotation and note impact. Audit logs retention for POC: 90 days.
rui.eng: Run started. 00:20 update: traffic stable ~298 qps aggregate. Chat avg latency 210ms, p95 640ms, p99 980ms. Embeddings avg 160ms p95 380ms.
alex.s: Any drops or 5xx?
rui.eng: Saw transient 502s when a node reconnected at t=47m, ~30 errors in 2 min while autoscaling reattached. Root cause: kube-probe flapping due to ephemeral CPU burn from batch compilation.
sam.ops: Handled — drained and replaced pod, increased node pool health timeout to 90s. No further errors.
priya.se: For the exec summary I'll note the transient error, mitigation, and recommended canary strategy. Also include cost sensitivity: switching 20% of traffic to 7b-8q saves ~18% in unit cost with small latency improvements.
alex.s: Can you upload per-minute csv and artifact links? Ember exec will want the raw data.
rui.eng: Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-poc/ember/1769504321/ (ember_chat_300qps.json, ember_embed_300qps.json, per_minute.csv, k8s-events.log)
deploy-bot: Upload complete. s3://redwood-poc/ember/1769504321/
priya.se: Drafting 1-pager now. Will include: overview, key metrics (sustained qps, p95/p99, total tokens processed), cost estimates, security notes (KMS rotation, audit retention), and recommended Dedicated commit to reach target unit costs.
alex.s: Thanks. I'll forward to EmberHealth and set up a 30-min review tomorrow. Good run team :white_check_mark:
Participants: alex.s, priya.se, rui.eng, sam.ops, olivia.support, deploy-bot
